cards.back: GDP = value of all final goods & services produced WITHIN the country's borders. GNP = GDP + Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA). For India, GNP < GDP since NFIA is negative.

cards.front: What are Repo Rate and Reverse Repo Rate?
cards.back: Repo: rate at which RBI lends short-term to banks against securities (injects liquidity). Reverse Repo: rate at which RBI borrows from banks (absorbs liquidity). Repo ↑ → borrowing costlier → inflation control.

cards.front: Define Fiscal Deficit, Revenue Deficit and Primary Deficit.
cards.back: Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Receipts (excl. borrowings). Revenue Deficit = Revenue Expenditure − Revenue Receipts. Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit − Interest Payments.

CRR: % of NDTL banks must keep as cash with RBI (no interest earned). SLR: % of NDTL banks must maintain in liquid assets (cash, gold, G-secs) with themselves. Both are quantitative tools of monetary policy.

cards.front: What are the components of the Current Account of BoP?
cards.back: 1) Trade in goods (visible), 2) Trade in services (invisibles), 3) Primary income (interest, dividends, remittances of profit), 4) Secondary income/transfers (remittances, gifts, aid).

cards.front: What is the difference between headline inflation (WPI/CPI) measures used in India?
cards.back: CPI (base 2012, by NSO) measures retail price change — used by RBI for the 4% ± 2% inflation target. WPI (base 2011-12, by Office of Economic Adviser) tracks wholesale prices, excludes services.

cards.front: What is FRBM Act and its key target?
cards.back: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003 — fiscal discipline framework. Amended target: fiscal deficit of 3% of GDP; the NK Singh Committee (2017) recommended a debt-to-GDP anchor (60% general govt).

cards.front: What is MSP and who recommends it? How many crops are covered?
cards.back: Minimum Support Price — announced by CCEA based on CACP (Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices) recommendations, for 22 mandated crops + FRP for sugarcane.

cards.front: Composition and mandate of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)?
cards.back: 6 members: RBI Governor (chair, casting vote), Deputy Governor, one RBI officer + 3 government nominees; decides the policy repo rate by majority to keep CPI inflation at 4% (±2%). Meets at least 4 times a year.

FDI: long-term investment with ownership/control (≥10% equity stake convention), brings technology & management. FPI: investment in financial assets (shares, bonds) without control — 'hot money', more volatile.
